entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand thing. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your order, could I get your name and order number?
It's Mark Peterson, order number 8-6-7-5-3-0-9. And don't give me the runaround, I'm already furious about this.

Okay, I have your account pulled up now, Mark. I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on January 2nd. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not faulty, it's just garbage! The whole thing is incredibly hard to use. The data on the screen is so confusing, I can't make heads or tails of it. I've read the user manual cover to cover and it's no help at all. Frankly, I expected more from VeloFit. This is a joke.

I understand the frustration when a new device isn't intuitive. Sometimes the customizable display settings can seem complex at first. Were you trying to view the real-time cadence graph or the summary screen?

I don't care what it's called! I'm not interested in a tutorial, I'm interested in a refund! Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager? I swear I will light up your social media pages with reviews about this.
That won't be necessary, Mark. I can definitely handle this for you. I just needed to understand the situation. Let me check the return eligibility for you right now.
You'd better. I've had it for, what, two or three weeks? It better be eligible.

Okay, I've just reviewed our policy. For the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, we have a 90-day return window. Your order was delivered 19 days ago, so you are well within that timeframe. I can approve this return for a full refund immediately.
Oh. Really? You're not going to fight me on it?

Not at all. Your satisfaction is our priority. I have just authorized the return in our system. You will receive an email in the next five minutes with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions on how to send the device back to us.
Huh. Okay then. That's... that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You are very welcome, Mark. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
